tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Cylinders and quotients] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0103 1. ch19:19.10\group Examples

The shrinking quotients $(S^{n-k}\times \mathbb R^k)/\Gamma $ with $n-k\ge 2$ are $\kappa $-solutions; the largest admissible $\kappa $ depends on $|\Gamma |$ and its action. In dimension three no uniform lower bound exists for arbitrary spherical space-form quotients. \end{example}
